experiment: Increase bounded semantic serving views from three to five while retaining two direct-delivery views and using later facets only as parser-backed graph probes.

decision.reason: The change produced no strict @64 gain, regressed strict @128 by 25 points, and materially increased query latency. Additional facet probes consumed bounded graph capacity without improving direct model recall.
decision.codeRetention: Remove the experiment from the serving path. Preserve only this checkpoint and the pushed experimental commit in Git history.

nextExperiment: Keep the three-view baseline and eliminate sequential graph-core/importer starvation in the enriched 64-slot addition using a single bounded evidence selection mechanism evaluated on train/calibration data.
